description.text: Starter Set VSTAR Darkrai, a 60-card deck released on 25 February 2022 with Lucario's, built around the new Darkrai VSTAR and its Darkrai V. Darkrai VSTAR's VSTAR Power takes back up to two Items from the discard pile, such as Dark Patch, which attaches a basic Darkness Energy from the discard pile to a Benched Darkness Pokémon. Both decks hold Crobat V, Quick Ball, Ultra Ball, Cynthia's Ambition, Professor's Research and Boss's Orders, and each came with a VSTAR marker, a playmat, a coin, damage counters and markers and a player's guide.
